Performance Roles
Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane


Performance Media Executive (also known as Performance Executive, Digital Activation Executive, Paid Search Executive, Senior Performance Executive, Senior Performance Media Executive)  
  
Role Overview   
The purpose of the Performance Media Executive is to assist in the implementation and management of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers. This role exists to support the Performance Media team across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation.  
   
Skills & Experience  
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.   
•	Supporting Account Managers and Directors across the team to deliver across account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copy-writing, quality-checks and best practice  
•	Own campaign execution in support to your Account Manager and Director, delivery and execution of a given customer campaign and/or account  
•	Assist in the development of insights for reporting, laddering up to the ‘so-what?’   
•	Own the building of new Search, Programmatic, Social campaign accounts ensuring a high level of detail is observed and we are aligned to the customer brief.  
•	Own the loading of monthly budgets and management of budget pacing through the month with Performance Media Coordinators.  
•	Own in the loading of proposed budgets into our invoicing system accurately and reconciling budgets on a monthly basis.   
•	Identify areas for account improvement and feed-back to Performance Media Managers and Directors and into Coordinators.  
•	Basic-Intermediate (12-24 months minimum) understanding and working knowledge of either SEM, Paid Social or Programmatic campaign build and/or management.  
•	Basic-Intermediate (6-24 months) understanding of Google or Adobe Analytics  
•	Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel   
•	Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Outlook)  
  
Salary: $85K - $90K package 


Performance Manager (Also known as Performance Media Manager, Associate Activation Manager, Digital Activation Manager, Paid Search Manager, Search Manager, Paid Social Manager, Social Manager, Programmatic Manager)

The purpose of the Performance Media Account Manager is to manage the delivery of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers/clients.
This role exists to deliver, with the support of the wider Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers.
Managing responsibilities of Executives and/or Coordinators to ensure account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copywriting, quality-checks and best practice. This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.
Salary: $85K - $110K package

Performance Director (Also known as Performance Media Director, Associate Activation Director, Digital Activation Director, Senior Search Manager, Search Director, Senior Paid Social Manager, Social Director, Programmatic Director)
The purpose of the Performance Director is to define industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers and also responsible for ensuring the best possible ROI for a client’s digital/performance media investment. This role exists to deliver, with the Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers/clients. Own the mid to senior customer relationship to ensure we are aligned with the customer and delivering on their business needs. Full responsibility for people management and account management/implementation within your team, and ensuring campaigns deliver against client KPIs. Responding to and presenting new business pitches.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams 
Salary: $110K - $140K package

All roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

result.description: ABI Civil Contracting NSW  We’re on the lookout for  experienced Formwork Carpenters  to join our team on a permanent, full-time basis.   At ABI Civil, you’ll work on key infrastructure projects across Sydney, with excellent rates and long-term opportunities.   Permanent full-time role (following short casual trial period)    What you’ll need to succeed:    Minimum 2–3 years’ experience as a Formwork Carpenter (or equivalent relevant experience)  Pre-employment medical (incl. drug & alcohol testing)  RIW Ticket (or willingness to obtain before starting)  Construction White Card  Australian working rights  Strong commitment to safety, teamwork, and site standards   At ABI Civil Contracting, we pride ourselves on delivering complex civil construction projects with a strong, supportive site culture.   Interested?   Apply now and join a company that values skill, safety, and career progression. Cox Purtell  
  Senior Salesforce System Administrator  
 You know Salesforce is only as strong as the way it is looked after. 
 Clean access. Sensible configuration. Stable releases. Good support. Strong governance. A platform people can actually rely on. 
 That is what this role is about. 
 You'll be joining a Brisbane-based university using Salesforce across existing and new platforms, including CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud. Some of the environment is established. Some of it is being improved and remediated. Your role will be to help look after the whole platform, not just one narrow part of it. 
 This will suit you if you are a hands-on Salesforce Administrator who likes ownership, cares about platform quality, and enjoys being close to the people who use the system. 
  The role  
 As the Senior Salesforce System Administrator, you'll help keep Salesforce stable, secure and useful across a large university environment. 
 You'll work across day-to-day administration, user support, configuration, platform improvement, release support and governance. 
 You'll be the person helping make sure Salesforce is well managed across CRM, marketing, engagement, alumni-style use cases and Education Cloud. 
 You'll work with the Salesforce Program Manager, architects, business analysts, DevOps specialists and business stakeholders. You won't be working in isolation, but you will be trusted to take real ownership of the admin layer of the platform. 
  What you'll be doing  
 You'll manage Salesforce users, roles, profiles, permission sets, licences and access controls. 
 You'll support Salesforce CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud usage across existing and new platform areas. 
 You'll provide practical support to users, helping resolve issues and improve how teams use Salesforce. 
 You'll configure Salesforce using declarative tools such as Flow, Approval Processes, Assignment Rules, Lightning pages, page layouts and permission structures. 
 You'll support sandbox management, release management and controlled deployment processes. 
 You'll help identify technical debt, platform risks, security issues and improvement opportunities. 
 You'll document changes, support adoption and create guidance that helps users get better value from Salesforce. 
 You'll help improve and remediate the platform while also keeping the current environment running properly. 
  What we're looking for  
 You'll bring strong hands-on Salesforce administration experience. 
 You might currently be a Salesforce Administrator, Senior Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce System Administrator, Salesforce Platform Administrator or Salesforce Consultant with strong admin capability. 
 Higher education experience would be useful, but it is not essential. 
 Experience in adjacent environments would be very relevant, particularly CRM, marketing, membership, alumni, engagement, customer service or stakeholder management platforms. 
 You'll be comfortable working in a complex Salesforce environment where different teams use the platform in different ways. 
 You'll understand Salesforce security, user access, profiles, permission sets, configuration, support and release processes. 
 Salesforce Administrator certification is preferred. If you are not certified yet but are actively working towards it, we are still happy to talk. 
  Why this role could be interesting  
 You'll have genuine ownership of a high-impact Salesforce platform. 
 You'll be involved in both improvement and remediation, not just routine ticket work. 
 You'll work across broad Salesforce use cases, including CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud. 
 You'll be part of a major university environment where Salesforce supports real engagement with students, staff, partners and alumni. 
 You'll have the chance to help create a strong higher-ed Salesforce case study. 
  Location  
 The university is based in Brisbane. 
 Brisbane-based candidates are very welcome and would spend regular time in the office. 
 We can also consider candidates in Sydney, Melbourne or other eastern Australian cities, provided you are willing to travel to Brisbane occasionally. As a guide, there will be an expectation to attend the Brisbane office at least once per month. 
  Work rights  
 We can only consider candidates with full work rights in Australia. 
 You will need to be an Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or New Zealand citizen. 
  Key details  
 Role: Senior Salesforce System Administrator Platform: Salesforce CRM, Marketing and Education Cloud Contract: 12-month fixed term contract, likely to extend Package: $160,000 plus superannuation Location: Brisbane preferred; Sydney, Melbourne and other eastern Australian cities considered Work rights: Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident or New Zealand citizen only 
  Interested?  
 Apply with your CV or get in touch for a confidential conversation. 
 This is a strong role if you want to own, improve and support a Salesforce platform that matters.

Performance Media Executive (also known as Performance Executive, Digital Activation Executive, Paid Search Executive, Senior Performance Executive, Senior Performance Media Executive, Senior Digital Activation Executive, Digital Activation Senior Executive)
 
Role Overview  
The purpose of the Performance Media Executive is to assist in the implementation and management of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers. This role exists to support the Performance Media team across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation. 
  
Skills & Experience 
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.  
•	Supporting Account Managers and Directors across the team to deliver across account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copy-writing, quality-checks and best practice 
•	Own campaign execution in support to your Account Manager and Director, delivery and execution of a given customer campaign and/or account 
•	Assist in the development of insights for reporting, laddering up to the ‘so-what?’  
•	Own the building of new Search, Programmatic, Social campaign accounts ensuring a high level of detail is observed and we are aligned to the customer brief. 
•	Own the loading of monthly budgets and management of budget pacing through the month with Performance Media Coordinators. 
•	Own in the loading of proposed budgets into our invoicing system accurately and reconciling budgets on a monthly basis.  
•	Identify areas for account improvement and feed-back to Performance Media Managers and Directors and into Coordinators. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (12-24 months minimum) understanding and working knowledge of either SEM, Paid Social or Programmatic campaign build and/or management. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (6-24 months) understanding of Google or Adobe Analytics 
•	Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel  
•	Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Outlook) 

Salary: $80K - $90K package

This role exists to deliver, with the support of the wider Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers.
Managing responsibilities of Executives and/or Coordinators to ensure account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copywriting, quality-checks and best practice. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Salary: $85K - $115K package

The purpose of the Performance Director is to define industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers and also responsible for ensuring the best possible ROI for a client’s digital/performance media investment. REQ674850 - St George Hospital - Clinical Nurse Educator - 7D Behavioural Support Unit & 7E Aged Care - Permanent Full Time

The Role

The vision for South Eastern Sydney Local Health District (SESLHD) is 'exceptional Care, healthier lives'. SESLHD is committed to enabling our community to be healthy and well, and to providing the best possible compassionate care when people need it. 

All staff are expected to act as an appropriate and effective role model and promote a culture and supporting practices that reflect the NSW Health CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Respect and Empowerment through demonstrated behaviours and interactions with patients, clients and employees. All staff are expected to take reasonable care that their actions do not adversely affect the health and safety of others, that they comply with any reasonable instruction that is given them with any reasonable policies-procedures relating to the health or safety in the workplace, as well as notifying any hazards-risks or incidents to their managers. 

The vision for nursing and midwifery at St George Hospital is to provide meaning and purpose to plan for the future;have reference to an inspirational statement that is consistent with the purpose and values of nursing and midwifery;and to inspire nurses and midwives to provide the highest quality healthcare to patients in any circumstance. 

The Vision Statement is 'Nurses and Midwives at St George hospital are always compassionate and competent in the delivery of excellent patient and family centered care'. Eight core behaviours were identified as being integral to achieving the vision:team player, caring, respectful, honest, advocate, collaborative, considerate and accountable. The Clinical Nurse Educator (CNE) provides coordination, delivery and evaluation of clinical nurse education (including programs) at the ward-unit level. Such education may include orientation and-or transitioning for new nursing staff, undergraduate and casual nurses as well as meeting the ongoing educational needs of existing nursing staff. Provide clinical supervision at the point of care within everyday clinical practice, in line with the ANMC Decision Making Frameworks for Nurses-Midwives. 

Benefits
 

Up to 12 allocated days off each year (for full-time employees) in addition to annual leave.

Salary packaging optionsthat reduce your taxable income and increase your take-home pay! Up to $9K for living expenses and $2.6K meal & entertainment & Novated Leasing.

Discounted gym memberships with a Fitness Passport.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and family members.

Discounted Private Health Insurance.

Selection Criteria

Current registration as a Registered Nurse with the Nursing & Midwifery Board of Australia.

Holds a relevant clinical or education post registration qualifications or such education and clinical experience deemed appropriate by the employer.

Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

Understanding of teaching and learning in the health care environment (adult learning principles).

Demonstrated clinical teaching & facilitation skills.

Demonstrated knowledge of competency attainment and assessment.

Demonstrated recent educational experience in an acute care facility.

Recommended applicants will be reviewed for compliance with NSW Health policy directive Occupational Assessment, Screening and Vaccination Against Specified Infectious Diseases for all positions prior to offer.
